description: This file contains functions for freezing and optimizing TorchScript modules, specifically scripts for PyTorch's JIT compilation. It defines functionalities to freeze modules, run optimizations on frozen graphs, and prepare models for inference by applying various transformations.

classes.name: RecursiveScriptModule
classes.description: A class representing a recursively scripted TorchScript module, used as the type for frozen modules.

methods.name: freeze( mod, preserved_attrs: Optional[list[str]] = None, optimize_numerics: bool = True )
methods.description: Freezes a ScriptModule by inlining submodules, parameters, and attributes as constants within the IR graph, optimizing for inference speed.

methods.name: None run_frozen_optimizations( mod, optimize_numerics: bool = True, preserved_methods: Optional[list[str]] = None )
methods.description: Performs a series of graph transformations to optimize a frozen ScriptModule, such as removing dropout and folding layers.

methods.name: ScriptModule optimize_for_inference( mod: ScriptModule, other_methods: Optional[list[str]] = None )
methods.description: Applies optimization passes to prepare a ScriptModule specifically for inference, including freezing it if necessary.

ctags.name: freeze
ctags.signature: ( mod, preserved_attrs: Optional[list[str]] = None, optimize_numerics: bool = True )

ctags.name: run_frozen_optimizations
ctags.signature: ( mod, optimize_numerics: bool = True, preserved_methods: Optional[list[str]] = None )
